commit_message:
access: one replay-line generator; compact_above counts events; never raise on open

- _replay_lines yields parsed lines with unstamped ts filled from the running
  max; _fold_streaming / _fold_buffered are module-level folds over it.
- compact_above counts event lines only (a compacted file is not rewritten on
  every open); validated as None or a non-negative int.
- auto-compaction failure warns once instead of raising from the constructor.
- tests: seeded fuzz of streaming vs buffered folds, inode/mtime regression,
  compaction-failure warning, compact_above validation.

Refs #32
